reason: Two web searches found no coverage of the 10-23 close or the coming FOMC, only that chips sold off in the week to 10-16 (Nasdaq -2.1%). The decision therefore rests mostly on the packet. Energy longs (XLE +8.9%, XOP +5.6%) are working and the momentum thesis is intact. SMH, XBI, TLT and XHB are each within 3.4% of entry and nowhere near their stops. Rotating the book would cost basis points without new evidence, so I keep the book as it stands.
